remarks: WELCOME TO PARKVIEW...This great first floor studio apartment is in the heart of downtown Stamford. This 1920s brick building is in walking distance to shops, restaurants, library, Uconn, theatres, a seasonal farmer's market and the train station. This is a corner unit with lots of light, hardwood floors, a large walk-in closet & heat, hot water and cooking gas are included. Laundry room is located on the lower level. Applicant must fill out a Parkview application for $100. Application is in the supplements. Good credit a must. There is a GARAGE. Photos are from prior tenant. Tenant would appreciate 24 hours notice.
